page_title: WHU 2-2 LIV | West Ham v Liverpool 27/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Anthony Taylor had an easy-decision to make.
90+3' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
90+2' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90+1' We are about to witness a substitution. Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is replacing Jarell Quansah.
90+1' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) latches on to a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a brilliant shot towards the goal, but he hits the crossbar!
89' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alisson is well positioned and punches the ball away.
87' Alphonse Areola (West Ham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
86' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) meets a cross on the edge of the box and produces a header towards the middle of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
86' There's an opportunity for Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
86' The ball is cleared after Joe Gomez (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
84' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
81' The corner kick from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) comes onto the pitch so that Wataru Endo can be given a rest.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Joe Gomez (Liverpool) is coming onto the pitch as Trent Alexander-Arnold cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Jurgen Klopp decides to make a substitution. Luis Diaz will be replaced by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool).
77' 2 - 2 Goal! Jarrod Bowen swings the ball deep into the box and finds Michail Antonio (West Ham) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the top right corner. 2:2.

75' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Alphonse Areola makes a great save to stop his effort.
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) for Tomas Soucek.
73' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
73' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Vladimir Coufal (West Ham).
70' > peeled away from his marker and got on the end of a cross inside the box. He attempted to head the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper made a block.

70' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Luis Diaz (Liverpool) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Alphonse Areola pulls off a brilliant save.
65' 1 - 2 Alphonse Areola (West Ham) sends the ball into his own net after a crazy goalmouth scramble.
65' Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
61' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
59' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post.
58' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

58' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Alphonse Areola was alert and the score remained the same. The linesman points to the corner flag, Liverpool are going to take it.
56' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
53' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
53' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

52' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Liverpool.
49' 1 - 1 Goal! Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Luis Diaz inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. 1:1.
47' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) blows a golden chance from inside the box, volleying the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a miss!
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Anthony Taylor has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' 1 - 0 Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) leaps to meet an excellent cross and steers a fantastic header past the goalkeeper, inside the right post.
43' West Ham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

43' A sweet pass finds Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Alisson is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball is out of play and West Ham manage to earn a corner.
42' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the left post.
39' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.

34' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Alphonse Areola is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.
31' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the left post. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
30' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Wataru Endo (Liverpool) for his blatant foul.

30' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Alphonse Areola is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
29' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Liverpool! Play can continue.
27' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Liverpool! Let's see what he decides.
27' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
25' Michail Antonio (West Ham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
21' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
19' A dangerous looking corner kick from Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is cleared to safety by the defence.
18' Half-chance! Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) plays a pass into the box, but Alphonse Areola reacts well to snuff out the attack.
15' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
14' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Alisson is equal to it and makes an easy save.
14' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
13' Emerson (West Ham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
12' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. West Ham have a corner.
11' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post.
8' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) wins the ball from the resulting free kick and blazes his shot high over the crossbar!
6' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lucas Paqueta (West Ham).
5' Emerson (West Ham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

5' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
2' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Liverpool will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor is introduced as the referee for today's match.
